summary: Official Google for Startups Accelerator pages are active and describe a global accelerator family with mentoring, technical support, product/design/leadership support, and equity-free participation, but the main accelerator landing page does not expose one current global application deadline or cohort date. Related official pages currently show multiple regional/vertical accelerators with separate timelines, so a single current catalog event cannot be safely merged without selecting a specific cohort.

sources.title: Google for Startups Accelerator
sources.supports: Official landing page for the Google for Startups Accelerator program family; describes accelerators as programs for top startup founders using Google products and notes offerings such as mentorship, technical support, and product, design, and leadership guidance.

sources.title: Google for Startups Accelerator: AI First
sources.supports: Shows that Google runs specific Google for Startups Accelerator cohorts under separate vertical pages; the AI First page says the program is equity-free and includes mentoring, training, and technical project support.

notes: The provided existing events already track specific Google for Startups Accelerator cohorts. The generic accelerator landing page should remain checked but not merged as a dated event unless the catalog wants a non-date program-family listing.
Use a specific official cohort page, such as a regional AI, climate, or energy accelerator page, for a mergeable event when applications or batch dates are public.
